content:
Hello there <:Saya_foto:1513124059334971402>

Horla :
> Not roused
Her 4 skills each trigger an emotion switch when they leap. Her emotion stays active until she leaps again, including between fight.
These emotions include crit up, strength generation boost, shield generation boost, aliemus generation boost, etc.
They all boost a part of their exalt correpsinding to their effet ( *i.e.* haminess increases aliemus gained )
- The hapiness emotion has a mechanical effect as well : your cards will no longer discard at turn end

> Roused
At turn start, Horla gains 1 stack of every emotion other than her current one. These stacks are auto-consumed when she leaps the corresponding psalm for additionnal effect ( max 3 stacks ).
- Turn X : You leap with Carol. Her emotion becomes hapiness ( passive boost )
She has no stack of either emotions.
- Turn X+1 : you rouse her. She still has so stack of either emotion
- Turn X+2 : turn start : she gains 1 of grief, anger and fear.
- Turn X+3 : turn start : she now has 2 stacks of grief, anger and fear.
You leap with snarl : she consumes all 2 stacks of anger to trigger the extra hit twice.
Her emotion becomes anger ( passive boost )
- Turn X+4 : turn start, she gains 1 stack of hapiness, fear and grief.
She now has
1 stack of hapiness
3 stacks of fear
3 stacks of grief
0 stacks of anger

Better ?

content:
As for Liz, her gimmick is simple but can be quite hard to manage.
Her fire can be used in two ways :

- when you don't have enough arithmetica, it gives her some aliemus
- When you retain them, green flame evolves into corrupted flame for improved effets ( can evolve further if you unlock by investing in her ).

Liz is a diva. She's quite lazy until you gather enough of an audience for a awe-inspiring show.
She wants you to retain as many of her flames as you can until her exalt is ready. Then, it's time to let the flames consume the stage.

- Her flames also evolve when stored in ultra space. If your hand is cramped you can choose to leap with them for more fire on the ultra round ( but do make sure her exalt is ready by then ! )
